meta.description: Generate professional clinical decision support (CDS) documents for pharmaceutical and clinical research settings, including patient cohort analyses (biomarker-stratified with outcomes) and treatment recommendation reports (evidence-based guidelines with decision algorithms). Supports GRADE evidence grading, statistical analysis (hazard ratios, survival curves, waterfall plots), biomarker integration, and regulatory compliance. Outputs publication-ready LaTeX/PDF format optimized for drug development, clinical research, and evidence synthesis.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated clinical data or trial results. Examples use realistic but clearly synthetic data with appropriate statistical ranges.

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate disclaimers present. Scope limited to group-level analyses for pharmaceutical research, not individual patient care. Clear distinction from bedside treatment plans.

methodological_ground.detail: Uses established GRADE evidence grading methodology. Statistical approaches appropriate for clinical trials and cohort analyses.

code_usability.detail: Hybrid mode with support scripts for data processing, but primary output is written documents rather than executable code.

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage of cohort analysis and treatment recommendations. Clear pharmaceutical research focus. Minor gap in example diversity.

reliability.note: Document structure requirements clearly specified. Validation scripts present. Error handling for edge cases not fully documented.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md at 507 lines is slightly long. Could benefit from more aggressive progressive disclosure to reference files.

agent_usability.note: Excellent structure with clear document types and use cases. Pharmaceutical context well-defined. Minor feedback design gaps for iterative refinement.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger language for pharmaceutical and clinical research contexts. Clear scope boundaries vs treatment-plans skill.

security.note: HIPAA de-identification and confidentiality headers mentioned. No patient data exposure patterns. Input validation for clinical data could be more explicit.

maintainability.note: Clean separation with support scripts for specific tasks. Document templates modular. No formal test cases for output validation.

agent_specific.note: Good trigger precision for pharmaceutical contexts. Strong composability with scientific-schematics skill. Executive summary requirement adds some verbosity.

inputs.label: Cohort analysis executive summary
inputs.note: Excellent clinical writing with proper statistical metrics and confidence intervals

assertions.text: Includes key outcome metrics (ORR, PFS, OS)
assertions.note: All standard efficacy endpoints present with specific values

assertions.text: Statistical significance properly reported with HR and CI
assertions.note: Hazard ratios, 95% confidence intervals, and p-values correctly formatted
Treatment sequencing and branching logic described
High, moderate, low, very low quality designations used
Clear separation of biomarker-positive and negative groups
Uses appropriate tests for categorical and survival outcomes
Biomarker data contextualized with clinical endpoints

key_strengths: Excellent pharmaceutical and clinical research focus with clear scope boundaries
Strong integration of statistical analysis with clinical writing
Proper use of GRADE evidence grading methodology for recommendations
Good composability with scientific-schematics skill for visual algorithms
Appropriate practice boundaries with disclaimers and HIPAA considerations

recommendations.title: Reduce SKILL.md length with progressive disclosure
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md at 507 lines is moderately long for initial context loading.
recommendations.root_cause: Detailed document structure requirements and multiple examples in main file.
recommendations.fix: Move detailed document templates and extended examples to reference files. Keep SKILL.md focused on core capabilities, when to use, and quick examples. Target under 400 lines.

recommendations.title: Add explicit validation for statistical claims
recommendations.problem: No explicit guidance on validating statistical values (e.g., checking if CI ranges are plausible, p-values match HR directions).
recommendations.root_cause: Focus on document formatting without statistical quality checks.
recommendations.fix: Add validation section documenting: consistency checks for HR/CI/p-value relationships, plausibility ranges for clinical metrics, automated validation script usage.

recommendations.title: Clarify when to use vs avoid this skill
recommendations.problem: While treatment-plans distinction is clear, boundary with other medical writing skills could be more explicit.
recommendations.root_cause: Focus on positive use cases without comprehensive out-of-scope guidance.
recommendations.fix: Add 'When NOT to Use' section covering: basic literature reviews (use different skill), case reports (use treatment-plans), health economics models (requires specialized skill), systematic reviews (different methodology).
